calibration_profile: Bundled audio described as Sir Simon Rattle / Berliner Philharmoniker (2010 EMI/Warner); recording identity not independently authenticated
silence_db_reference: RMS amplitude relative to maximum measured 80 ms RMS frame independently in each movement

method.audio_features: 8 kHz mono PCM; 8192-point Hann STFT; 4000-sample hop (0.5 s); spectrally whitened 12-bin chroma, 55–2500 Hz
method.score_features: Junji Miki MIDI pitched-note chroma at 0.5 s, velocity sqrt weight plus 0.18 fifth-harmonic weight; channel 10 excluded
method.alignment: cosine-distance DTW, symmetricP1 slope constraint, normalized diagonal band ±0.16; a second symmetric2 path using the same features reports path ambiguity, not independent ground truth
method.backend: local bounded audio-data readout (one movement at a time); no solver or simulation run
method.uncertainty_hint: max(0.75 s, 0.5 s + half the two-path disagreement); a non-statistical review hint, not a measured error bound or confidence interval

provenance.midi_credit: Junji Miki (catalog attribution); no Kaplan/IGMG edition claim
provenance.score_numbering_note_en: The task bar counts are retained as an atlas display axis. MIDI setup/pickup measures and free-time subdivisions differ; source_grid_bar and source_q preserve the actual digitization coordinates. Movement IV has about 68 full measures plus a pickup in this source, not 140 critical-edition measures.
provenance.score_numbering_note_zh: 保留任务指定的小节数作为图谱显示轴。来源MIDI的设置小节、弱起及自由速度细分与之不同；source_grid_bar和source_q保留数字化版本的实际坐标。该来源第四乐章约有68个完整小节及弱起，不能把140格显示轴称为批判版小节数。
provenance.recording_identity_note_en: The official catalog lists Movement I at 24:16, versus bundled 22:34. A 102 s discrepancy prevents certification as the complete unedited release; no cause is assumed.
provenance.recording_identity_note_zh: 官方目录第一乐章时长24分16秒，内置文件22分34秒，相差102秒，不能据此认证为完整未剪辑的官方发行；不推断差异成因。

bar_axis_mapping.1: MIDI grid identity (445 requested bars); source grid not independently critical-edition certified
bar_axis_mapping.2: MIDI pickup grid 1 folds into atlas bar 1; subsequent display bar = source_grid_bar - 1
bar_axis_mapping.3: MIDI pickup grid 1 folds into atlas bar 1; subsequent display bar = source_grid_bar - 1
bar_axis_mapping.4: MIDI pickup folded into first atlas bar; source full-bar grid 2–69 mapped proportionally to requested atlas axis 1–140; not a score-bar identity
bar_axis_mapping.5: Grid 1–448 identity; free-time grid 448–475 mapped to atlas448–472; thereafter display=grid-3; chorus junction at atlas472 / grid475 is a reference correspondence, intervening bars provisional
